title: 俗世凡尘 第7章 医道中俗世凡尘 第8章 医道下

落霞峰云药堂。
“弟子陆多福，给师叔祖请安！”
决定要跟温老头学医的第二日，陆多福一大早就赶到此处拜见温老头。此时温老头正拿着一壶药酒，徐徐斟入一个青色小瓷杯。酒香四溢，呈暗红色，也不知道泡的什么东西。温老头小心翼翼地抬起酒杯，凑近鼻子深深嗅了一口，脸上露出满足的神色。陆多福神色一动，平日里一丝不苟的温师叔祖，居然也喜好这杯中之物，一大早就喝上酒了。
见到陆多福来，温老头放下酒杯，点点头道：“嗯，不错，你这娃娃来的倒是挺早的。吃过早饭没？我这吃的简单，你随意用些，别饿着肚子，学不到本事。”温老头指了指桌上的小米粥和咸菜。
“回师叔祖，弟子吃过了。”陆多福答道。还在天水城的时候，陆多福是没有吃早饭的习惯的，乡下人一天两顿有的吃就不错了。后来当乞丐，一天有一顿饱饭已经烧高香了。但是自打进了云隐门，在白云溪的监督下，陆多福彻底改变了不吃早饭这种“恶习”。管你饿不饿，白云溪都会抓着南宫月和陆多福一日三餐按时吃，而且吃不完不许走，还不准浪费。
“那行！别饿着就行！”温老头也不是个啰嗦的人，跟人三番五次客套这种事他是干不出来的，指着酒道：“一起喝点？”
陆多福愕然：“师叔祖，这……”
“呃，算了！我交代你事情，你去忙吧！”温老头自己也觉得不合适，陆多福才十岁，未成年人还是要好好保护。温老头轻咳一声，指着墙边柜台：“看那，小娃娃，这一个月内你啥都不用干，把那三本书给背熟记牢了。”
那三本书，记载的都是医术药理方面的粗浅知识，每本都有两寸厚，其中一本陆多福已经看过。这么多内容，一个月内，好像挺难的。陆多福信心不足，杵在柜台边上，有些手足无措。
温老头斜眼看着陆多福：“怎么，一个月时间还不够？你这不行啊，既然决心跟老夫学，就要肯下苦功夫，想当年老夫……”
“不，一个月够了，师叔祖，我一定会好好背的！”陆多福道，但这话有点口不由心，他自己也没有十分把握。可若是当面表示为难，未免让温师叔祖瞧不起，万一给他留下不好的印象，以后不好好教自己怎么办。
温老头哈哈一笑，点头道：“这还差不多，小娃娃记性好，背几本书不费吹灰之力。去吧，到里面去好好读，有不懂的就来问老夫！”
云药堂里面还有一座小院，主要供温老头生活起居用。陆多福依言拿了医书，走进内院，找了把椅子就坐着看起来。书里内容很杂，什么人身之五脏五行，肺属金、心属火、肝属木、肾属水、脾属土，又是什么药有五味，酸、苦、甘、辛、咸，还有什么温热寒凉四气……
这不是看故事会，书里的东西还大都看不懂，对于陆多福这么大年纪的孩子来说，实在太过枯燥。陆多福之前来云药堂扎针的时候，因为是要排队，拿本书装装样子，看一些内容。要是旁人见了，还会夸上两句，谁家孩子这么爱读书，真是勤奋好学等等……小孩子都喜欢被夸的，有人夸，陆多福看的也认真，就事半功倍，随随便便就记住百十来个穴位了。
可这会静下心来一个人看，就实在太乏味了，陆多福看的犯困。一个多时辰后，两眼一闭，靠在椅子上呼呼大睡。梦里啥都有，陆多福过目不忘，短短半个时辰，记住了三本书里的全部内容，惊得温老头直呼祖宗，从此陆多福学了一身传神医术，飞黄腾达……
“醒醒，吃饭了小鬼！”
陆多福睁开眼睛，见温老头笑眯眯地看着自己，马上意识到打瞌睡了，不由得涨红了脸，嗫嗫嚅嚅地道：“师叔祖，我……我……”
“行了，不就是打个瞌睡嘛，意料之中。”温老头笑了笑，一副我很懂你的样子，看来这老倌当年也没少瞌睡。温老头引着陆多福到厨房，给他添了一碗饭，递到他手上。陆多福受宠若惊，赶忙致谢：“师叔祖，我自个来。”随后反客为主伺候起温老头来，端茶递水不在话下。
午饭吃的还是不错的，四菜一汤，有鸡有鱼，看得出来温老头很在意陆多福这个后辈，每样菜都做足了分量。他自己确实吃得很少，每样都是浅尝辄止，剩下的全部进了陆多福的肚子。不过温老头照例喝了一杯酒。

吃完了饭，陆多福抢着收拾碗筷去洗，并且不让温老头插手，温老头倒也没有坚持，点头含笑，面露嘉许之色。
“小子，看累的时候睡下无妨，但我要你记下的东西，你还得按时完成了。”温老头留下这样一句话，慢悠悠地出去散步去了。
所谓响鼓不用重锤敲，温老头这看似漫不经心的提醒，陆多福却是牢牢记住了。为了克服打瞌睡这个坏习惯，他弄了两根小木棍，困的时候就拿来撑住了眼皮。接下来的几日，陆多福再也没打过瞌睡。
为了充分利用时间，陆多福白天黑夜都带着这些书，连上茅房的时候都没有撇下。某日听南宫月说，看书的时候大声朗读出来，有助于加深印象，更容易记住。于是陆多福不分时间地点场合，只要是在看书，都会大声念出来。最后温老头实在让他吵得受不了了，直接把他赶出了云药堂，命其在吃饭时候再回来。
“主伤中，五劳六极，羸瘦，崩中，脉绝，补虚益气……”
第十九天，陆多福自信满满地站在温老头面前，将书本归还给温老头，之后流畅地背诵了下来。千里之行始于足下，一开始陆多福见到这三本书就感觉信心不足，可等正式开始背了，才发觉并没有想想中的那么难。
这些医书都是先辈们经过几万年的积累，去芜存菁留下的经典之作。对于医术作出系统的归纳，药材也根据药性做了分类，这样就更容易记住了。还有个重要的原因就是，这书里的字挺大的，其实内容没多少，有些地方还画着插图。最关键的，十岁上下的小孩子，正是记忆力最好的时候，哪怕陆多福不是过目不忘的神童，但多读几遍后，还是能记住。
“嗯，不错不错，十成倒是记住了九成九，看得出来是下了苦功夫了。”温老头满意地点点头，可接着脸色一转：“但是小子，剩下的那一分，老夫还是要提醒你。可要记住了，寒是寒，冷是冷，不可混为一谈。气和味要分开，不可记混了。还有……”
温老头喋喋不休，将陆多福背诵有误的地方给一一指出来，足足说了大半个时辰。陆多福听是听进去了，但心里却有些不服气，温师叔祖是不是太刻板了些。温老头似是看出了陆多福的心思，只是笑笑就没再说。
既然会背了，温老头就要教他。先将几本书里面的内容一一讲解，让陆多福记住。在此环节，陆多福有任何问题，都可以发问。每隔几天温老头都要抽一些出来考考陆多福，有时候陆多福没记住，感觉很不好意思时，温老头都不以为意，这让陆多福心下稍安。
对于药材，温老头不但每一样都要亲自带着陆多福了解，从气味，药性，药效，再后来还要亲自培植照顾，最后到制成药，都要亲自监督陆多福来完成。
足足学了八个月后，陆多福将那三本书每一处都记牢了，每一种药光靠鼻子闻闻就能分辨出来，并且准确的说出生长习性，药性，药效和忌讳，制作，存储方法等等。温老头这时候才告诉陆多福：“好了，老夫可以正式传授你医术了。”
陆多福一头栽倒在地，敢情这八个月下来，才堪堪摸到门槛……

Luoxiafeng Yunyao Hall.
"Disciple Lu Duofu, please give my regards to my great uncle!"
The day after he decided to study medicine with Old Man Wen, Lu Duofu rushed here early in the morning to meet Old Man Wen. At this time, Old Man Wen was holding a pot of medicinal wine and slowly poured it into a small cyan porcelain cup. The wine was fragrant, dark red in color, and I didn’t know what it was soaked in. Old Man Wen carefully raised the wine glass, brought it close to his nose and took a deep sniff, with a satisfied look on his face. Lu Duofu's expression changed. Uncle Wen, who was usually meticulous, actually liked what was in this cup and drank it early in the morning.
Seeing Lu Duofu come, Old Man Wen put down his wine glass, nodded and said, "Well, that's right, you little one came quite early. Have you had breakfast? What I eat is simple, you can use what you want, don't go hungry and fail to learn your skills." Old Man Wen pointed to the millet porridge and pickles on the table.
"Uncle, my disciple has eaten." Lu Duofu replied. When he was still in Tianshui City, Lu Duofu didn't have the habit of eating breakfast. It was good for country people to have two meals a day. Later he became a beggar and had a full meal a day that was worth burning incense. But since entering Yunyinmen, under the supervision of Bai Yunxi, Lu Duofu has completely changed his "bad habit" of skipping breakfast. Regardless of whether you are hungry or not, Baiyun Xi will make Nangong Yue and Lu Duofu eat three meals a day on time, and they are not allowed to leave until they finish eating, and they are not allowed to waste it.
"That's okay! Just don't be hungry!" Old Man Wen was not a wordy person. He couldn't do things like being polite to people over and over again. He pointed at the wine and said, "Let's drink some together?"
Lu Duofu was stunned: "Uncle Master, this..."
"Uh, forget it! I'll tell you what to do, and you can go and do your work!" Old Man Wen himself felt it was inappropriate. Lu Duofu was only ten years old, and minors should still be protected. Old Man Wen coughed lightly and pointed to the counter by the wall: "Look, little baby, you don't have to do anything in this month. You have memorized those three books."
Those three books all recorded superficial knowledge of medical techniques and pharmacology. Each of them was two inches thick. Lu Duofu had already read one of them. It seems quite difficult to cover so much content in one month. Lu Duofu lacked confidence and stood at the counter, a little at a loss.
Old Man Wen looked sideways at Lu Duofu: "What, one month is not enough? You can't do this. Since you are determined to learn from me, you must be willing to work hard. Think of me back then..."
"No, one month is enough, Uncle Master, I will definitely memorize it well!" Lu Duofu said, but his words were a little careless, and he himself was not very sure. But if he expresses his embarrassment in person, it will inevitably make Uncle Wen look down on him. If he leaves a bad impression on him, he will not teach himself what to do in the future.
Old Man Wen laughed and nodded: "That's about right. The little kid has a good memory and can easily memorize a few books. Go ahead and read it inside. If you don't understand anything, just ask me!"
There is also a small courtyard inside Yunyao Hall, which is mainly used for Old Man Wen's daily life. Lu Duofu took the medical book as instructed, walked into the inner courtyard, found a chair and sat down to read. The content in the book is very complicated. What are the five internal organs and five elements of the human body? The lungs belong to metal, the heart belongs to fire, the liver belongs to wood, the kidneys belong to water, and the spleen belongs to earth. What medicines have five flavors: sour, bitter, sweet, pungent, salty, and the four qi of warm, hot, cold, and cool...
This is not a story-telling session. Most of the things in the book are incomprehensible. It is too boring for a child of Lu Duofu's age. When Lu Duofu came to Yunyaotang for acupuncture before, he had to queue up, so he took a book to show off and read some contents. If other people see it, they will praise it, saying, whose child loves reading so much, is really diligent and studious, etc... Children like to be praised. If someone praises him, Lu Duofu will pay attention to it seriously, and he will get twice the result with half the effort, and he can memorize more than a hundred acupuncture points casually.
But it was so boring to calm down and watch it alone. Lu Duofu felt sleepy while watching it. more than an hourFinally, he closed his eyes, leaned on the chair and fell asleep. There was everything in the dream, and Lu Duofu had a photographic memory. In just half an hour, he remembered all the contents of the three books. He was so surprised that Old Man Wen called his ancestors. From then on, Lu Duofu learned a magical medical skill and became famous...
"Wake up, it's time to eat, kid!"
Lu Duofu opened his eyes and saw old man Wen looking at him with a smile. He immediately realized that he had dozed off and couldn't help but blush. He muttered: "Uncle Master, I...I..."
"Okay, I just took a nap, it's expected." Old Man Wen smiled, as if he understood you very well. It seems that this old man also had a lot of naps back then. Old Man Wen led Lu Duofu to the kitchen, added a bowl of rice to him, and handed it to him. Lu Duofu was flattered and hurriedly thanked him: "Master, uncle, I'll come by myself." Then he turned into a guest and served Old Man Wen, serving tea and water without hesitation.
The lunch was quite good, with four dishes and one soup, including chicken and fish. It was obvious that Old Man Wen cared about Lu Duofu, a junior, and every dish was prepared in sufficient portions. He did eat very little, and only tasted a small amount of everything. The rest went into Lu Duofu's stomach. But Old Man Wen drank a glass of wine as usual.
After finishing the meal, Lu Duofu rushed to clean up the dishes and wash the dishes without letting Old Man Wen interfere. Old Man Wen did not insist, but nodded with a smile and a look of approval on his face.
"Boy, it's okay to sleep when you're tired, but you have to finish what I want you to write down on time." Old Man Wen left these words and went out for a walk leisurely.
As the saying goes, you don’t need a heavy hammer to hit a drum. Lu Duofu firmly remembered Old Man Wen’s seemingly casual reminder. In order to overcome the bad habit of dozing off, he got two small wooden sticks and used them to prop up his eyelids when he was sleepy. In the following days, Lu Duofu never dozed off again.
In order to make full use of his time, Lu Duofu took these books with him day and night, even when he went to the latrine. One day I heard Nangong Yue say that reading aloud while reading can help deepen the impression and make it easier to remember. So Lu Duofu would read it out loud regardless of time, place or occasion, as long as he was reading. In the end, Old Man Wen couldn't bear the noise anymore and kicked him out of Yunyao Hall, ordering him to come back during dinner time.
"Mainly injured, five types of labor and six extremes, thinness, collapse, pulse failure, tonifying deficiency and replenishing qi..."
On the nineteenth day, Lu Duofu stood confidently in front of Old Man Wen, returned the book to Old Man Wen, and then recited it fluently. A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step. When Lu Duofu first saw these three books, he felt lack of confidence. But when he started memorizing them, he realized that it was not as difficult as he thought.
These medical books are classic works left behind by our ancestors after tens of thousands of years of accumulation, eliminating the unnecessary and retaining the essential. Medical skills are systematically summarized, and medicinal materials are also classified according to their medicinal properties, making it easier to remember. Another important reason is that the text in this book is quite large, but the content is actually not much, and there are illustrations in some places. The most important thing is that children around ten years old have the best memory. Even if Lu Duofu is not a child prodigy with photographic memory, he can still remember it after reading it several times.
"Well, not bad, not bad. Ninety-nine percent of it is remembered. It can be seen that he has put in hard work." Old Man Wen nodded with satisfaction, but then his expression changed: "But boy, I still have to remind you of the remaining part. But remember, cold is cold, cold is cold, and cannot be confused. Gas and taste must be separated, and cannot be mixed. And..."
Old Man Wen kept chattering, pointing out the mistakes in Lu Duofu's recitation one by one, and talked for more than half an hour. Lu Duofu listened, but he was a little unconvinced. Uncle Wen was too rigid. Old Man Wen seemed to see what Lu Duofu was thinking, and just smiled and said nothing more.
Now that he can memorize it, Old Man Wen willteach him. Let me first explain the contents of several books one by one so that Lu Duofu can remember them. During this session, if Lu Duofu has any questions, he can ask them. Every few days, Old Man Wen would take some out to test Lu Duofu. Sometimes when Lu Duofu didn't remember and felt embarrassed, Old Man Wen didn't take it seriously, which made Lu Duofu feel at ease.
Regarding the medicinal materials, Old Man Wen not only had to personally take Lu Duofu to understand everything, but also personally cultivated and cared for them from smell, medicinal properties, and efficacy. Finally, he had to personally supervise Lu Duofu to complete the finished medicine.
After studying for eight months, Lu Duofu memorized every part of the three books. He could distinguish each medicine just by smelling it, and accurately described the growth habits, medicinal properties, efficacy and taboos, production and storage methods, etc. Only then did Old Man Wen tell Lu Duofu: "Okay, I can officially teach you medical skills."
Lu Duofu fell to the ground, feeling that after eight months, he could barely touch the threshold...
